usedFor: Mailparser turns emails into structured data, and HubSpot receives the sender through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, so the same sender updates one contact and never creates two.

watchOut: “New Parsed Email (one request per row)” fires per row, so one email with many rows runs the action repeatedly.
